prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1275; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The right rear quarter panel and rear passenger door show scraping and creasing along their lower edges, with paint transfer and a cracked side marker lens. The damage pattern lines up with the reported sideswipe during a lane change, and the vehicle shows no sign of older impact damage in the same area. Repairs call for replacing the marker lens, blending the paint on the quarter panel, and straightening and refinishing the door skin. The labor hours on the estimate are consistent with the work described, and the parts and charges listed appear only once with no duplicate entries. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
